steps.eval: (() => { const P = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot, C = P.querySelector('#chg').shadowRoot; const seen = (globalThis.__progs = []); const note = () => { const p = C.querySelector('.prog'); const t = p && !p.hidden ? p.textContent : ''; if (seen.at(-1) !== t) seen.push(t); }; new MutationObserver(note).observe(C.querySelector('.chg-pop'), { subtree: true, childList: true, characterData: true, attributes: true }); return 1; })()

(() => { const P = document.querySelector('phitex-preview').shadowRoot, C = P.querySelector('#chg').shadowRoot; globalThis.__drawn = false; new MutationObserver((rs) => rs.some((r) => [...r.addedNodes].some((n) => n.classList?.contains('bl-paint') && n.querySelector('rect'))) && P.querySelectorAll('.slot svg.bl-marks .w').length > 0 && (globalThis.__drawn = true)).observe(P.querySelector('#stage'), { childList: true, subtree: true }); return 1; })()
